ast.scope: Explicit gap: no syntax projection or semantic AST.

obernants.scope: U is valid world history to ordered built-fact vectors. R emits only the explicit event/entity/delta cases then sorts and renumbers. U minus R includes n-position mismatch, ordinary Set facts for skipped Type/Class/Parent/A/B/Mother/Father/PartOf fields, and removal facts from ignored set-removal deltas.

Given built facts, compatible histories retain all ignored fields and deltas plus arbitrary changes invisible to current names and emitted text. Fact projection is not injective; preserve every history yielding the same facts.
With previous tags p and current c, emit c minus p when nonempty; else emit end=true only when c empty and p nonempty; otherwise no feeling fact. Then p becomes c, so partial removal is silent.

For emitted tuples (line,old_n), final order is ascending pair and new_n=position. Reverse from final vectors recovers relative line order but not original category iteration unless source kind constraints are retained.

coverage.description: Construct fields and typed facts from event roles, current plans/beliefs, state deltas and relation snapshots; sort by line and insertion order and renumber.
